cues.zh: 而听讲座的时间却太少，

cues.en: I had a knack for passing examinations.
cues.zh: 我却有通过考试的诀窍。

cues.en: And that, for years, had been the measure of success in my life and that of my peers.
cues.zh: 而那，多年来，一直是我和我同龄人成功的衡量标准。

cues.en: Now, I am not dull enough to suppose that because you are young, gifted and well-educated, you have never known heartbreak,
cues.zh: 现在，我还不至于愚钝到认为，因为你们年轻、有天赋、受过良好教育，就从未经历过心碎，

cues.en: hardship or heartache.
cues.zh: 艰难或痛苦。

cues.en: Talent and intelligence never yet innoculated anyone against the caprice of the fates.
cues.zh: 天赋和智慧从未能使任何人免受命运的捉弄。

cues.en: And I do not for a moment suppose that everyone here has enjoyed an existence of unruffled privilege and contentment.
cues.zh: 我丝毫也不认为这里的每个人都享受过一帆风顺的特权和满足的生活。

cues.en: However, the fact that you are graduating from Harvard suggests that you are not very well acquainted with failure.
cues.zh: 然而，你们即将从哈佛毕业的事实表明，你们对失败并不十分熟悉。

cues.en: You might be driven by a fear of failure quite as much as a desire for success.
cues.zh: 你们可能同样被对失败的恐惧所驱动，也同样被对成功的渴望所驱动。

cues.en: Indeed, your conception of failure might not be too far removed from the average person's idea of success, so high have you already flown.
cues.zh: 事实上，你们对失败的理解可能与普通人对成功的看法相差无几，因为你们已经飞得太高了。

cues.en: Ultimately, we all have to decide for ourselves what constitutes failure.
cues.zh: 最终，我们都必须自己决定什么构成失败。

cues.en: But the world is quite eager to give you a set of criteria if you let it.
cues.zh: 但如果你允许，世界非常乐意给你一套标准。

cues.en: So I think it fair to say that by any conventional measure, a mere seven years after my graduation day, I had failed on an epic scale.
cues.zh: 所以，我认为可以公平地说，按照任何传统的标准，在我毕业后的短短七年里，我就已经彻底失败了。

cues.en: An exceptionally short-lived marriage had imploded, and I was jobless.
cues.zh: 一段异常短暂的婚姻破裂了，我失业了。

cues.en: A lone parent, and as poor as it is possible to be in modern Britain without being homeless.
cues.zh: 一个单身父母，而且穷得几乎和无家可归一样，在现代英国。

cues.en: The fears that my parents had had for me, and that I had had for myself, had both come to pass.
cues.zh: 我的父母曾对我的担忧，以及我自己曾对自己的担忧，都成为了现实。

cues.en: And by every usual standard, I was the biggest failure I knew.
cues.zh: 按照所有通常的标准，我是我所认识的最失败的人。

cues.en: Now I'm not going to stand here and tell you that failure is fun.
cues.zh: 现在我不会站在这里告诉你失败很有趣。

cues.en: That period of my life was a dark one.
cues.zh: 我生命中的那个时期是黑暗的。

cues.en: And I had no idea that there was going to be what the press has since represented as a kind of fairy tale resolution.
cues.zh: 我当时完全不知道，后来媒体所描绘的那种童话般的结局将会出现。

cues.en: I had no idea then how far the tunnel extended, and for a long time, any light at the end of it was a hope rather than a reality.
cues.zh: 我当时不知道隧道有多长，很长一段时间，隧道尽头的任何光亮都只是希望，而非现实。

cues.en: So why do I talk about the benefits of failure?
cues.zh: 那么，我为什么要谈论失败的好处呢？

cues.en: Simply because failure meant a stripping away of the inessential.
cues.zh: 仅仅因为失败意味着剥离了不必要的东西。

cues.en: I stopped pretending to myself that I was anything other than what I was,
cues.zh: 我不再自欺欺人地认为自己是别的什么，除了我本来的样子，

cues.en: and began to direct all my energy into finishing the only work that mattered to me.
cues.zh: 并开始将我所有的精力都投入到完成对我来说唯一重要的工作。

cues.en: Had I really succeeded at anything else, I might never have found the determination to succeed in the one arena where I believed I truly belonged.
cues.zh: 如果我在其他任何事情上都取得了成功，我可能永远也找不到决心在那个我认为我真正属于的领域取得成功。

cues.en: I was set free.
cues.zh: 我被解放了。

cues.en: Because my greatest fear had been realized, and I was still alive, and I still had a daughter whom I adored, and I had an old typewriter and a big idea.
cues.zh: 因为我最大的恐惧已经实现，而我还活着，我仍然有一个我深爱的女儿，我有一台旧打字机和一个宏大的想法。

cues.en: And so, rock bottom became the solid foundation on which I rebuilt my life.
cues.zh: 因此，跌至谷底成为了我重建生活的坚实基础。

cues.en: You might never fail on the scale I did, but some failure in life is inevitable. It is impossible to live without failing at something.
cues.zh: 你可能永远不会像我那样规模地失败，但生活中的某些失败是不可避免的。不经历失败地生活是不可能的。

cues.en: Unless you live so cautiously that you might as well not have lived at all, in which case you fail by default.
cues.zh: 除非你生活得如此谨慎，以至于你还不如没有活过，那样的话你就默认失败了。

cues.en: Failure gave me an inner security that I had never attained by passing examinations. Failure taught me things about myself that I could have learned no other way.
cues.zh: 失败给了我一种内在的安全感，这是我从未通过考试获得的。失败让我了解了自己，这是我用其他任何方式都无法学到的。

cues.en: I discovered that I had a strong will, and more discipline than I had suspected.
cues.zh: 我发现我意志坚强，而且比我预想的更有纪律性。

cues.en: I also found out that I had friends whose value was truly above the price of rubies.
cues.zh: 我还发现我拥有价值真正高于宝石的朋友。

cues.en: The knowledge that you have emerged wiser and stronger from setbacks means that you are ever after, secure in your ability to survive.
cues.zh: 知道你从挫折中变得更明智、更强大，意味着你从此以后，能够自信地生存下去。

cues.en: You will never truly know yourself, or the strength of your relationships, until both have been tested by adversity.
cues.zh: 你永远不会真正了解自己，或你人际关系的强度，直到两者都经受了逆境的考验。

cues.en: Such knowledge is a true gift, for all that it is painfully won.
cues.zh: 这样的知识是一份真正的礼物，尽管它是痛苦地赢得的。

cues.en: And it has been worth more than any qualification I ever earned.
cues.zh: 它比我获得的任何资格都更有价值。

cues.en: So, given a time turner, I would tell my 21-year-old self that personal happiness lies in knowing that life is not a checklist of acquisition or achievement.
cues.zh: 所以，如果给我一个时间转换器，我会告诉21岁的自己，个人的幸福在于知道生活不是一份获取或成就的清单。

cues.en: Your qualifications, your CV, are not your life.
cues.zh: 你的资历，你的简历，都不是你的生活。

cues.en: Though you will meet many people of my age and older who confuse the two.
cues.zh: 尽管你会遇到许多和我同龄或更年长的人，他们会混淆这两者。

cues.en: Life is difficult and complicated and beyond anyone's total control.
cues.zh: 生活是艰难而复杂的，并且超出了任何人的完全控制。

cues.en: And the humility to know that will enable you to survive its vicissitudes.
cues.zh: 而认识到这一点所带来的谦逊，将使你能够承受其变迁。

cues.en: Now, you might think that I chose my second theme, the importance of imagination, because of the part it played in rebuilding my life, but that is not wholly so.
cues.zh: 现在，你可能会认为我选择我的第二个主题，想象力的重要性，是因为它在我重建生活中所扮演的角色，但并非完全如此。

cues.en: Though I personally will defend the value of bedtime stories to my last gasp.
cues.zh: 尽管我个人会拼死捍卫睡前故事的价值。

cues.en: I have learned to value imagination in a much broader sense.
cues.zh: 我已经学会了从更广泛的意义上重视想象力。

cues.en: Imagination is not only the uniquely human capacity to envision that which is not, and therefore the fount of all invention and innovation.
cues.zh: 想象力不仅是人类独有的能够设想不存在之物的能力，因此也是所有发明和创新的源泉。

cues.en: In its arguably most transformative and revelatory capacity, it is the power that enables us to empathize with humans whose experiences we have never shared.
cues.zh: 在其可以说是最具变革性和启示性的能力中，它使我们能够同情那些我们从未分享过经历的人类。

cues.en: One of the greatest formative experiences of my life preceded Harry Potter, though it informed much of what I subsequently wrote in those books.
cues.zh: 我生命中最伟大的形成性经历之一发生在《哈利·波特》之前，尽管它启发了我后来在那些书中写下的许多内容。

cues.en: This revelation came in the form of one of my earliest day jobs.
cues.zh: 这一启示来自于我最早的日间工作之一。

cues.en: Though I was sloping off to write stories during my lunch hours, I paid the rent in my early twenties by working at the African Research Department of Amnesty International's headquarters in London.
cues.zh: 尽管我在午休时间溜出去写故事，但我二十出头时靠在伦敦大赦国际总部非洲研究部工作来支付房租。

cues.en: There in my little office, I read hastily scribbled letters, smuggled out of totalitarian regimes by men and women who were risking imprisonment to inform the outside world of what was happening to them.
cues.zh: 在那里，在我小小的办公室里，我阅读了那些被来自极权主义政权下的男女们匆忙写下的信件，他们冒着被监禁的风险将这些信件偷运出来，告知外界他们所遭受的一切。

cues.en: I saw photographs of those who had disappeared without trace, sent to Amnesty by their desperate families and friends.
cues.zh: 我看到了那些被送往大赦组织、被绝望的家人和朋友送来的、失踪得无影无踪的人的照片。

cues.en: I read the testimony of torture victims and saw pictures of their injuries.
cues.zh: 我阅读了酷刑受害者的证词，并看到了他们伤痕的照片。

cues.en: I opened handwritten eyewitness accounts of summary trials and executions, of kidnappings and rapes.
cues.zh: 我打开了手写的目击者陈述，其中记录了简易审判和处决、绑架和强奸。

cues.en: Visitors to our offices included those who had come to give information or to try and find out what had happened to those who they had left behind.
cues.zh: 来我们办公室的访客包括那些前来提供信息或试图了解他们所留下的人的遭遇的人。

cues.en: I shall never forget the African torture victim, a young man no older than I was at the time, who had become mentally ill after all he had endured in his homeland.
cues.zh: 我永远不会忘记那位非洲遭受酷刑的受害者，他是一位年轻的男子，当时比我大不了多少，他在祖国所遭受的一切使他精神失常。

cues.en: He trembled uncontrollably as he spoke into a video camera about the brutality inflicted upon him.
cues.zh: 他对着摄像机讲述自己遭受的残酷对待时，无法控制地颤抖着。

cues.en: He was a foot taller than I was and seemed as fragile as a child.
cues.zh: 他比我高一英尺，看起来像孩子一样脆弱。

cues.en: I was given the job of escorting him back to the underground station afterwards, and this man, whose life had been shattered by cruelty, took my hand with exquisite courtesy and wished me future happiness.
cues.zh: 之后，我被派去护送他回地下车站，这位生命被残忍摧毁的男子，彬彬有礼地握住我的手，祝我未来幸福。

cues.en: And as long as I live, I shall remember walking along an empty corridor and suddenly hearing from behind a closed door, a scream of pain and horror such as I have never heard since.
cues.zh: 只要我还活着，我就会记得，我曾沿着一条空荡荡的走廊走着，突然听到一扇关着的门后传来一声痛苦和恐惧的尖叫，那是我此生从未听过的声音。

cues.en: The door opened, and the researcher poked out her head and told me to run and make a hot drink for the young man sitting with her.
cues.zh: 门开了，研究员探出头来，让我去给坐在她旁边的那个年轻人冲一杯热饮。

cues.en: She had just had to give him the news that in retaliation for his outspokenness against his country's regime, his mother had been seized and executed.
cues.zh: 她刚刚不得不告诉他一个消息，作为对他反对国家政权的直言不讳的报复，他的母亲已被逮捕并处决。

cues.en: Every day of my working week in my early twenties, I was reminded how incredibly fortunate I was to live in a country with a democratically elected government where legal representation and a public trial were the rights of everyone.
cues.zh: 在我二十出头工作的每一天，我都提醒自己，生活在一个拥有民选政府的国家是多么幸运，在那里，法律代表和公开审判是每个人的权利。

cues.en: Every day, I saw more evidence about the evils humankind will inflict on their fellow humans to gain or maintain power.
cues.zh: 每一天，我都看到了更多证据，证明人类为了获得或维持权力会对同类施加的邪恶。

cues.en: I began to have nightmares, literal nightmares, about some of the things I saw, heard, and read.
cues.zh: 我开始做噩梦，字面意义上的噩梦，关于我所看到、听到和读到的一些事情。

cues.en: And yet, I also learned more about human goodness at Amnesty International than I had ever known before.
cues.zh: 然而，我在大赦国际也比以往任何时候都更多地了解了人性的善良。

cues.en: Amnesty mobilizes thousands of people who have never been tortured or are imprisoned for their beliefs, to act on behalf of those who have.
cues.zh: 大赦组织动员了成千上万从未遭受过酷刑或因信仰被监禁的人们，代表那些遭受过酷刑或被监禁的人采取行动。

cues.en: The power of human empathy, leading to collective action, saves lives and frees prisoners.
cues.zh: 人类同理心的力量，导致集体行动，拯救生命并释放囚犯。

cues.en: Ordinary people, whose personal well-being and security are assured, join together in huge numbers to save people they do not know and will never meet.
cues.zh: 普通人，他们的个人福祉和安全得到保障，却以巨大的数量团结起来，拯救他们不认识也永远不会遇到的人。

cues.en: My small participation in that process was one of the most humbling and inspiring experiences of my life.
cues.zh: 我在那个过程中微小的参与是我一生中最谦卑和最鼓舞人心的经历之一。

cues.en: Unlike any other creature on this planet, human beings can learn and understand without having experienced. They can think themselves into other people's places.
cues.zh: 与地球上任何其他生物不同，人类可以在没有亲身经历的情况下学习和理解。他们可以设身处地地为他人着想。

cues.en: Of course, this is a power like my brand of fictional magic, but it is morally neutral. One might use such an ability to manipulate or control, just as much as to understand or sympathize.
cues.zh: 当然，这是一种力量，就像我所说的虚构魔法一样，但它是道德中立的。人们可以利用这种能力来操纵或控制，就像理解或同情一样。

cues.en: And many prefer not to exercise their imaginations at all. They choose to remain comfortably within the bounds of their own experience, never troubling to wonder how it would feel to have been born other than they are.
cues.zh: 而许多人根本不愿意运用他们的想象力。他们选择舒适地停留在自己经验的范围内，从不费心去想，如果出生在与他们不同的境遇下会是什么感觉。

cues.en: They can refuse to hear screams or peer inside cages. They can close their minds and hearts to any suffering that does not touch them personally. They can refuse to know.
cues.zh: 他们可以拒绝听到尖叫声，或窥视笼子里面。他们可以对任何不触及他们个人痛苦的事情关闭心智和心灵。他们可以选择不知道。

cues.en: I might be tempted to envy people who can live that way, except that I do not think they have any fewer nightmares than I do.
cues.zh: 我可能会忍不住羡慕那些可以那样生活的人，但我认为他们做的噩梦并不比我少。

cues.en: Choosing to live in narrow spaces leads to a form of mental agoraphobia, and that brings its own
cues.zh: 选择生活在狭窄的空间里会导致一种精神上的广场恐惧症，而这会带来它自己的

cues.en: I think the willfully unimaginative see more monsters.
cues.zh: 我认为那些故意缺乏想象力的人会看到更多的怪物。

cues.en: They are often more afraid.
cues.zh: 他们常常更加害怕。

cues.en: What is more, those who choose not to empathize enable real monsters.
cues.zh: 更重要的是，那些选择不共情的人助长了真正的怪物。

cues.en: For without ever committing an act of outright evil ourselves, we collude with it through our own apathy.
cues.zh: 因为我们自己从未犯下公然作恶的行为，却通过自身的冷漠与之勾结。

cues.en: One of the many things I learned at the end of that classics corridor, down which I ventured at the age of 18, in search of something I could not then define, was this:
cues.zh: 在我18岁时，为了寻找当时无法定义的东西，我沿着那条古典学走廊走到了尽头，在那里我学到了许多东西，其中之一就是这个：

cues.en: written by the Greek author Plutarch.
cues.zh: 这是希腊作家普鲁塔克写的。

cues.en: What we achieve inwardly will change outer reality.
cues.zh: 我们内在的成就将改变外在的现实。

cues.en: That is an astonishing statement and yet proven a thousand times every day of our lives.
cues.zh: 这是一个惊人的陈述，但却在我们生活的每一天被证明了成千上万次。

cues.en: It expresses in part our inescapable connection with the outside world, the fact that we touch other people's lives simply by existing.
cues.zh: 它在一定程度上表达了我们与外部世界不可避免的联系，我们仅仅通过存在就触及了别人的生活。

cues.en: But how much more are you, Harvard graduates of 2008, likely to touch other people's lives?
cues.zh: 那么，2008届哈佛毕业生们，你们有多大的可能触及别人的生活呢？

cues.en: Your intelligence, your capacity for hard work, the education you have earned and received,
cues.zh: 你们的智慧，你们努力工作的能力，你们赢得和接受的教育，

cues.en: give you unique, unique status and unique responsibilities.
cues.zh: 赋予你们独特的、独特的地位和独特的责任。

cues.en: Even your nationality sets you apart.
cues.zh: 甚至你们的国籍也使你们与众不同。

cues.en: The great majority of you belong to the world's only remaining superpower.
cues.zh: 你们绝大多数人都属于世界上唯一仅存的超级大国。

cues.en: The way you vote, the way you live, the way you protest, the pressure you bring to bear on your government has an impact way beyond your borders.
cues.zh: 你们投票的方式，生活的方式，抗议的方式，你们对政府施加的压力，都远远超出了你们的国界。

cues.en: That is your privilege and your burden.
cues.zh: 这是你们的特权，也是你们的负担。

cues.en: If you choose to use your status and influence to raise your voice on behalf of those who have no voice,
cues.zh: 如果你选择利用你的地位和影响力，为那些没有声音的人发声，

cues.en: if you choose to identify not only with the powerful but with the powerless,
cues.zh: 如果你选择不仅与强者认同，也与弱者认同，

cues.en: if you retain the ability to imagine yourself into the lives of those who do not have your advantages, then it will not only be your proud families who celebrate your existence,
cues.zh: 如果你能保持想象自己置身于那些不如你幸运的人的生活中的能力，那么庆祝你存在的将不仅仅是你的骄傲的家人，

cues.en: but thousands and millions of people whose reality you have helped to change.
cues.zh: 还有成千上万的人，他们的现实因你而改变。

cues.en: We do not need magic to transform our world.
cues.zh: 我们不需要魔法来改变我们的世界。

cues.en: We carry all the power we need inside ourselves already.
cues.zh: 我们已经拥有了我们所需的一切力量。

cues.en: We have the power to imagine better.
cues.zh: 我们有能力想象更美好的未来。

cues.en: I'm nearly finished.
cues.zh: 我快说完了。

cues.en: I have one last hope for you.
cues.zh: 我最后还有一个希望寄托在你们身上。

cues.en: Which is something that I already had at 21.
cues.zh: 这是我21岁时就已经拥有的东西。

cues.en: The friends with whom I sat on graduation day have been my friends for life.
cues.zh: 毕业那天和我同坐的朋友们，一直是我一生的朋友。

cues.en: They are my children's godparents, the people to whom I've been able to turn in times of real trouble.
cues.zh: 他们是我孩子的教父母，是我在真正遇到困难时可以依靠的人。

cues.en: People who have been kind enough not to sue me when I took their names for death eaters.
cues.zh: 那些在我把他们的名字用作食死徒时，好心到没有起诉我的人。

cues.en: At our graduation, we were bound by enormous affection, by our shared experience of a time that could never come again,
cues.zh: 在我们的毕业典礼上，我们被巨大的情谊所束缚，被我们共同经历的永不复刻的时光所束缚，

cues.en: and of course, by the knowledge that we held certain photographic evidence that would be exceptionally valuable if any of us ran for prime minister.
cues.zh: 当然，还有我们知道我们掌握着某些照片证据，如果其中任何一个人竞选首相，这些证据将具有非凡的价值。

cues.en: So today, I wish you nothing better than similar friendships.
cues.zh: 所以今天，我祝愿你们拥有同样美好的友谊。

cues.en: And tomorrow, I hope that even if you remember not a single word of mine, you remember those of Seneca, another of those old Romans I met when I fled down the classics corridor,
cues.zh: 明天，我希望即使你们不记得我说过的任何一句话，你们也能记住塞内加的话，他是我在逃离古典学走廊时遇到的另一位古罗马人，

cues.en: in retreat from career ladders, in search of ancient wisdom.
cues.zh: 当时我正从职业阶梯上退下来，寻找古老的智慧。

cues.en: As is a tale, so is life.
cues.zh: 人生如故事。

cues.en: Not how long it is, but how good it is, is what matters.
cues.zh: 重要的不是它有多长，而是它有多好。

cues.en: I wish you all very good lives.
cues.zh: 我祝愿你们所有人都拥有非常美好的生活。

cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢。

material.title: 黄仁勋 · 加州理工毕业演讲
material.subtitle: 英文原声 · 双语字幕 · 完整演讲

cues.en: It really makes me cringe listening to all that.
cues.zh: 听到这些我真的浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

cues.en: Thank you for that kind introduction, but but um, I I hate hearing about myself.
cues.zh: 谢谢你这么好的介绍，但是但是嗯，我我讨厌听到关于我自己的事情。

cues.en: And and, just just to as a show show what maybe if you could just applaud.
cues.zh: 而且而且，只是只是为了展示，也许你们可以鼓掌一下。

cues.en: How many of you know who Nvidia is?
cues.zh: 你们有多少人知道英伟达是谁？

cues.en: And how many of you know what a GPU is?
cues.zh: 你们有多少人知道什么是GPU？

cues.en: Okay, good, I don't have to change my speech.
cues.zh: 好的，很好，我不用改我的演讲稿了。

cues.en: Ladies and gentlemen, President Rosenbaum,
cues.zh: 女士们先生们，罗森鲍姆校长，

cues.en: esteemed faculty members, distinguished guests,
cues.zh: 尊敬的教职员工，各位贵宾，

cues.en: proud parents.
cues.zh: 自豪的父母们。

cues.en: And above all, the 2024 graduating class of Caltech.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，2024届加州理工学院的毕业生们。

cues.en: This is a really happy day for you guys. You yeah, look more excited.
cues.zh: 这对你们来说真是个开心的日子。你们，是的，看起来更兴奋了。

cues.en: You know you're graduating from Caltech.
cues.zh: 你们知道你们要从加州理工学院毕业了。

cues.en: This is the school of the great Richard Feynman, Linus Pauling, and
cues.zh: 这是伟大的理查德·费曼、莱纳斯·鲍林所在的学校，还有

cues.en: someone who's very influential to me and our industry, Carver Mead.
cues.zh: 对我以及我们行业非常有影响力的人，卡弗·米德。

cues.en: Yeah, this is a very big deal.
cues.zh: 是的，这是一个非常重大的事件。

cues.en: Today is a day of immense pride and joy. It is a dream come true for all of you.
cues.zh: 今天是一个充满自豪和喜悦的日子。这是你们所有人的梦想成真。

cues.en: But not just for you, because your parents and families have made countless sacrifices to see you reach this milestone.
cues.zh: 不仅仅是为你们，因为你们的父母和家人付出了无数的牺牲才看到你们达到这个里程碑。

cues.en: So let's take this moment and congratulate them, thank them, and let them know you love them.
cues.zh: 所以让我们抓住这一刻，祝贺他们，感谢他们，让他们知道你们爱他们。

cues.en: You don't want to forget that because you don't know how long you're going to be living at home.
cues.zh: 你们不想忘记这一点，因为你们不知道还要在家住多久。

cues.en: You want to be super grateful today.
cues.zh: 你们今天应该非常感激。

cues.en: As a proud parent, I really loved it when my parent my kids didn't move out.
cues.zh: 作为一个自豪的父母，我真的很喜欢我的孩子没有搬出去的时候。

cues.en: And it was great to see them every day. But now they've moved out and makes me sad.
cues.zh: 每天看到他们很棒。但现在他们搬出去了，这让我很难过。

cues.en: So hopefully you guys you guys get to spend some time with your parents.
cues.zh: 所以希望你们，你们能花些时间和你们的父母在一起。

cues.en: Your journey here is a testament of your character, determination, willingness to make sacrifices for your dreams.
cues.zh: 你们在这里的旅程证明了你们的品格、决心和为梦想牺牲的意愿。

cues.en: And you should be proud.
cues.zh: 你们应该感到自豪。

cues.en: The ability to make sacrifices, endure pain and suffering.
cues.zh: 做出牺牲、忍受痛苦和折磨的能力。

cues.en: You will need these qualities in life.
cues.zh: 你们在生活中需要这些品质。

cues.en: You and I share some things in common.
cues.zh: 你和我有一些共同之处。

cues.en: First, both chief scientists of Nvidia were from Caltech.
cues.zh: 首先，英伟达的两位首席科学家都来自加州理工学院。

cues.en: And one of the reasons why I'm giving this speech today is because I'm recruiting.
cues.zh: 我今天发表这篇演讲的原因之一是我正在招聘。

cues.en: And so, I want to tell you that Nvidia is a really great company.
cues.zh: 所以，我想告诉你们，英伟达是一家非常优秀的公司。

cues.en: I'm a very nice boss.
cues.zh: 我是一个非常好的老板。

cues.en: Universally loved.
cues.zh: 普遍受欢迎。

cues.en: Come work at Nvidia.
cues.zh: 来英伟达工作吧。

cues.en: You and I share a passion for science and engineering.
cues.zh: 你和我对科学和工程都有热情。

cues.en: And although we're separated by about 40 years, we are both at the peaks of our careers.
cues.zh: 虽然我们之间相隔约40年，但我们都处于职业生涯的巅峰。

cues.en: For all of you who have been paying attention to Nvidia and myself, you know what I mean.
cues.zh: 对于所有关注英伟达和我的人来说，你们知道我的意思。

cues.en: It's just that in your case, you'll have many, many more peaks to go.
cues.zh: 只是在你们的情况下，你们还有很多很多个巅峰要去攀登。

cues.en: I just hope that today is not my peak.
cues.zh: 我只希望今天不是我的巅峰。

cues.en: Not the peak.
cues.zh: 不是巅峰。

cues.en: And so I'm working as hard as ever to make sure that I have many more peaks ahead.
cues.zh: 所以我正努力工作，确保我还有许多未来的巅峰。

cues.en: Last year I was honored to give the commencement address at Taiwan University.
cues.zh: 去年我有幸在台湾大学发表了毕业典礼演讲。

cues.en: And I shared several stories about Nvidia's journey and the lessons that we learned that might be valuable for graduates.
cues.zh: 我分享了几个关于英伟达旅程的故事，以及我们学到的可能对毕业生有价值的经验。

cues.en: I have to admit that I don't love giving advice.
cues.zh: 我必须承认，我不喜欢给建议。

cues.en: Especially to other people's children.
cues.zh: 尤其是给别人的孩子。

cues.en: And so my advice today will largely be disguised in some stories that that that I've enjoyed.
cues.zh: 所以我今天的建议将很大程度上伪装在我享受过的一些故事里。

cues.en: And some some life experiences that that I've enjoyed.
cues.zh: 以及一些我享受过的人生经历。

cues.en: I'm the longest running tech CEO in the world today, I believe.
cues.zh: 我相信我是当今世界上任职时间最长的科技公司CEO。

cues.en: Over the course of 31 years, I managed not to go out of business, not get bored and not get fired.
cues.zh: 在31年的时间里，我设法没有倒闭，没有感到厌倦，也没有被解雇。

cues.en: And so I have the the great privilege of of enjoying a lot of life's experiences on starting from creating Nvidia from nothing to what it is today.
cues.zh: 因此，我拥有巨大的荣幸，从零开始创建英伟达到今天，享受了许多人生经历。

cues.en: And so I spoke about the long road of creating CUDA, a programming model, the programming model that we dedicated over 20 years to invent.
cues.zh: 因此，我谈到了创建CUDA的漫长道路，一个编程模型，我们花了20多年时间发明这个编程模型。

cues.en: And that is revolutionizing computing today.
cues.zh: 它正在彻底改变今天的计算。

cues.en: I spoke about a very quite public canceled Sega game console project we worked on.
cues.zh: 我谈到了我们曾经参与的一个非常公开的、被取消的世嘉游戏机项目。

cues.en: And where intellectual honesty, something that I know Richard Feynman cares very deeply about and spoke quite often about.
cues.zh: 以及在那里，我深知理查德·费曼非常关心并经常谈论的智力诚实。

cues.en: Where intellectual honesty and humility saved our company.
cues.zh: 智力诚实和谦逊拯救了我们的公司。

cues.en: And how a retreat, a strategic retreat was one of our best strategies.
cues.zh: 以及一次撤退，战略性撤退，是我们最好的策略之一。

cues.en: All of these are counterintuitive lessons that I spoke about at commencement.
cues.zh: 所有这些都是我在毕业典礼上谈到的反直觉的教训。

cues.en: But I encouraged the graduates to engage with AI.
cues.zh: 但我鼓励毕业生们拥抱人工智能。

cues.en: The most consequential technology of our time.
cues.zh: 我们这个时代最具影响力的技术。

cues.en: And I'll speak a little bit more about that later, but all of you know about AI.
cues.zh: 我稍后会多谈一些，但你们都知道人工智能。

cues.en: It's hard not to be immersed in it and surrounded by it and a great deal of discussion about it.
cues.zh: 很难不沉浸其中，被它包围，并进行大量讨论。

cues.en: And of course, I hope that all of you are using it and playing with it.
cues.zh: 当然，我希望你们都在使用它，玩转它。

cues.en: With surprising results and some magical, some some disappointing and some surprising.
cues.zh: 带来令人惊喜的结果，有些神奇，有些令人失望，有些令人惊喜。

cues.en: But you have to enjoy it, you have to engage it.
cues.zh: 但你必须享受它，你必须参与其中。

cues.en: Because it's advancing so quickly.
cues.zh: 因为它正在飞速发展。

cues.en: It is the only technology that I've known that has that is advancing on multiple exponentials at the same time.
cues.zh: 它是我所知的唯一一项同时在多个指数级上发展的技术。

cues.en: And so the technology is changing very very quickly.
cues.zh: 因此，技术正在飞速变化。

cues.en: So I advised, I advised the students at the Taiwan University to to run, don't walk.
cues.zh: 所以我建议，我建议台湾大学的学生们去奔跑，不要行走。

cues.en: And engage the AI revolution.
cues.zh: 并拥抱人工智能革命。

cues.en: And yet one year later, it's incredible how much has changed.
cues.zh: 然而一年后，变化之大令人难以置信。

cues.en: And so today, what I wanted to do is share with you my perspective.
cues.zh: 所以今天，我想做的是与你分享我的观点。

cues.en: My from my vantage point of some of the important things that are happening.
cues.zh: 从我的角度来看，一些重要的事情正在发生。

cues.en: That you're graduating into.
cues.zh: 你们正在步入其中。

cues.en: And these are these are extraordinary things that are happening that that you should have an intuitive understanding for.
cues.zh: 这些都是正在发生的非凡之事，你应该对此有直观的理解。

cues.en: Because it's going to matter to you, it's going to matter to the industry.
cues.zh: 因为它对你很重要，对行业也很重要。

cues.en: And hopefully, you take advantage of the opportunity ahead of you.
cues.zh: 而且希望你能抓住眼前的机遇。

cues.en: The computer industry is transforming from its foundations, literally from studs.
cues.zh: 计算机行业正在从其基础发生转变，字面意义上是从螺柱开始。

cues.en: Everything is changing from studs on up.
cues.zh: 一切都在发生变化，从螺柱往上。

cues.en: And across every layer and soon every industry will also be transformed.
cues.zh: 并且在每一层，很快，每个行业也将被转变。

cues.en: And the reason for that is quite obvious because computers today are the single most important instrument of knowledge.
cues.zh: 原因很明显，因为今天的计算机是知识最重要的单一工具。

cues.en: And it's foundational to every single industry and every field of science.
cues.zh: 它也是每个行业和每个科学领域的基础。

cues.en: If we are transforming the computer so profoundly, it will of course have implications in every industry.
cues.zh: 如果我们如此深刻地改变计算机，它当然会对每个行业产生影响。

cues.en: And I'll talk about that in just a little bit.
cues.zh: 我稍后会谈到这一点。

cues.en: And as you enter industry, it's important you know what's happening.
cues.zh: 当你进入这个行业时，了解正在发生的事情很重要。

cues.en: Modern computing traces back to the IBM System 360.
cues.zh: 现代计算可以追溯到IBM 360系统。

cues.en: That was the architecture manual that I learned from.
cues.zh: 那是我学习的架构手册。

cues.en: It's an architecture manual that you don't need to learn from.
cues.zh: 这是一本你不需要学习的架构手册。

cues.en: A lot has a lot better better documentation and and better descriptions of computers and architecture has has been presented since.
cues.zh: 很多方面都有更好的文档和对计算机和架构的更好描述，自那以后一直如此。

cues.en: But the System 360 was incredibly important of of its time and in fact, the basic ideas of the System 360, the architecture of it,
cues.zh: 但360系统在其时代非常重要，事实上，360系统的基本思想，它的架构，

cues.en: the principle ideas and architecture and strategy of the System 360 are still governing the computer industry today.
cues.zh: 360系统的原则思想、架构和战略至今仍在指导着计算机行业。

cues.en: And it was introduced a year after my birth.
cues.zh: 它在我出生一年后被引入。

cues.en: In the 80s, I was among the first generation of VLS I engineers
cues.zh: 在80年代，我是第一代VLSI工程师之一

cues.en: who learned to design chips from Mead and Conway's landmark textbook.
cues.zh: 他们从Mead和Conway的里程碑式教科书中学习设计芯片。

cues.en: And I I'm not sure if it's still being taught here, it should be
cues.zh: 我不确定这里是否还在教授，但应该教授

cues.en: and the introduction of VLSI systems.
cues.zh: 以及VLSI系统的引入。

cues.en: Based on Carver Mead's pioneering work here at Caltech on chip design methodologies and textbook that revolutionized IC design.
cues.zh: 基于Carver Mead在加州理工学院在芯片设计方法学和教科书方面的开创性工作，彻底改变了集成电路设计。

cues.en: And it enabled our generation to design super giant chips and ultimately the CPU.
cues.zh: 它使我们这一代人能够设计超大芯片，并最终设计出CPU。

cues.en: The CPU led to exponential growth in computing.
cues.zh: CPU带来了计算的指数级增长。

cues.en: The performance, the incredible technology advances, that's called Moore's Law, fueled the information technology revolution.
cues.zh: 性能，令人难以置信的技术进步，这就是所谓的摩尔定律，推动了信息技术革命。

cues.en: The industrial revolution that we are part of, that my generation was part of, saw the mass production of something the world had never seen before.
cues.zh: 我们所处的工业革命，我那一代人所处的工业革命，看到了前所未有的东西的大规模生产。

cues.en: The mass production of something that was invisible.
cues.zh: 一种看不见的东西的大规模生产。

cues.en: Easy to copy.
cues.zh: 易于复制。

cues.en: The mass production of software.
cues.zh: 软件的大规模生产。

cues.en: And it led to a $3 trillion industry.
cues.zh: 它催生了一个三万亿美元的产业。

cues.en: When I sat where you sat, the IT industry was minuscule.
cues.zh: 当我坐在你们现在坐的位置时，IT行业微不足道。

cues.en: And the concept that you could make money selling software was a fantasy.
cues.zh: 而销售软件就能赚钱的概念曾是幻想。

cues.en: And yet today, it's one of the most important commodities, most important technologies and product creations that are industry produces.
cues.zh: 然而今天，它是我们行业生产的最重要的商品、最重要的技术和产品创造之一。

cues.en: However, the limits of Dennard scaling of transistor scaling and instruction level parallelism have slowed CPU performance.
cues.zh: 然而，Dennard缩放、晶体管缩放和指令级并行性的限制已经减缓了CPU的性能。

cues.en: And the the slowed CPU performance gains is happening at a time when computing demand continues to grow exponentially.
cues.zh: 而CPU性能提升的放缓，正发生在计算需求持续呈指数级增长之际。

cues.en: This exponentially growing gap between demand of computing and the capabilities of computers, if not addressed, computing energy consumption and cost inflation
cues.zh: 这种计算需求与计算机能力之间呈指数级增长的差距，如果得不到解决，计算能源消耗和成本通胀

cues.en: would eventually stifle every industry.
cues.zh: 最终将扼杀所有行业。

cues.en: We see very clear signs of computing inflation as we speak.
cues.zh: 我们现在就看到了计算通胀的非常明显的迹象。

cues.en: And after two decades of advancing in, in, and VLIW's CUDA, in VLIW's accelerated computing, offers a path forward.
cues.zh: 在经历了二十年的发展之后，VLIW的CUDA，VLIW的加速计算，提供了一条前进的道路。

cues.en: That's the reason why I'm here.
cues.zh: 这就是我在这里的原因。

cues.en: Because finally the industry realized of the incredibly incredible effectiveness of accelerated computing at precisely the time that we're witnessing computing inflation after several decades.
cues.zh: 因为行业终于认识到了加速计算在恰好我们目睹了几十年后计算通胀的令人难以置信的有效性。

cues.en: By offloading time consuming algorithms to a GPU that specializes in parallel processing, we routinely achieve 10, 100, sometimes a thousandfold speed ups, saving money, cost and energy.
cues.zh: 通过将耗时的算法卸载到专门从事并行处理的GPU上，我们通常可以实现10倍、100倍，有时甚至1000倍的加速，节省金钱、成本和能源。

cues.en: We now accelerate domains from computer graphics, ray tracing, of course, to gene sequencing, scientific computing, astronomy, quantum circuit simulations, SQL data processing, and even Pandas data science.
cues.zh: 我们现在加速的领域从计算机图形学、光线追踪，当然还有基因测序、科学计算、天文学、量子电路模拟、SQL数据处理，甚至Pandas数据科学。

cues.en: Accelerated computing has reached a tipping point.
cues.zh: 加速计算已经达到了一个临界点。

cues.en: That is our first great contribution to the computer industry.
cues.zh: 这是我们对计算机行业做出的第一个伟大贡献。

cues.en: Our first great contribution to society: accelerated computing.
cues.zh: 我们对社会做出的第一个伟大贡献：加速计算。

cues.en: It now gives us a path forward for sustainable computing where cost will continue to decline as computing requirement continues to grow.
cues.zh: 它现在为我们提供了可持续计算的前进道路，随着计算需求的不断增长，成本将持续下降。

cues.en: A hundredfold, a hundredfold of anything in time or cost or energy savings.
cues.zh: 百倍，任何方面百倍的时间或成本或能源节省。

cues.en: That accelerated computing opened, surely would trigger a new development somewhere else. We just didn't know what it was.
cues.zh: 加速计算的开放，肯定会在其他地方引发新的发展。我们只是不知道是什么。

cues.en: Until deep learning came to our consciousness.
cues.zh: 直到深度学习进入我们的意识。

cues.en: A whole new world of computing emerged.
cues.zh: 一个全新的计算世界出现了。

cues.en: Jeff Hinton, Alex Krizhevsky and Ilya Sutskever used Nvidia CUDA GPUs to train AlexNet and shocked the computer vision community by winning the 2012 ImageNet challenge.
cues.zh: 杰夫·辛顿、亚历克斯·克里热夫斯基和伊利亚·苏茨克维用英伟达CUDA GPU训练了AlexNet，并通过赢得2012年ImageNet挑战赛震惊了计算机视觉界。

cues.en: This was the big moment, the big bang of deep learning.
cues.zh: 这是重大时刻，是深度学习的大爆炸。

cues.en: A pivotal moment in that marked the beginning of the AI revolution.
cues.zh: 一个关键时刻，标志着人工智能革命的开始。

cues.en: Our decisions after AlexNet transformed our company.
cues.zh: 我们在AlexNet之后的决定改变了我们的公司。

cues.en: Is something that's worth taking note of.
cues.zh: 是值得注意的事情。

cues.en: Our decisions after AlexNet transformed our company and likely everything else.
cues.zh: 我们在AlexNet之后的决定改变了我们的公司，很可能也改变了其他一切。

cues.en: We saw the potential of deep learning and believed.
cues.zh: 我们看到了深度学习的潜力并相信。

cues.en: Just believed through principle thinking, believed through our own analysis of the scalability of deep learning. We believed the approach could learn other valuable functions.
cues.zh: 通过原则性思考，通过我们自己对深度学习可扩展性的分析，我们相信这种方法可以学习其他有价值的功能。

cues.en: That maybe deep learning is a universal function learner.
cues.zh: 也许深度学习是一个通用的函数学习器。

cues.en: And how many problems are difficult or impossible to express using fundamental first principles.
cues.zh: 有多少问题难以或不可能用基本的第一原理来表达。

cues.en: And so when we saw this, when we saw this, we thought, this is a technology we really have to pay attention to.
cues.zh: 所以当我们看到这个，当我们看到这个，我们认为，这是我们必须真正关注的一项技术。

cues.en: Because its limits are potentially only limited by model and data scale.
cues.zh: 因为它的限制可能仅限于模型和数据规模。

cues.en: However, there were challenges at the time.
cues.zh: 然而，当时存在挑战。

cues.en: This is 2012, shortly after 2012.
cues.zh: 这是2012年，2012年不久之后。

cues.en: How could we explore the limits of deep learning without having to build these massive GPU clusters?
cues.zh: 我们如何在不构建这些海量GPU集群的情况下探索深度学习的极限？

cues.en: At the time we were a rather small company, building these massive GPU clusters could cost hundreds and hundreds of millions of dollars.
cues.zh: 当时我们是一家相当小的公司，构建这些海量GPU集群可能花费数亿美元。

cues.en: And if we didn't, though, there was no assurance that it would, it would be, be effective if we scaled.
cues.zh: 但如果我们不这样做，也不能保证如果我们扩展它就会有效。

cues.en: However, no one knew how far deep learning could scale, and if we didn't build it, who would, we'd never know.
cues.zh: 然而，没有人知道深度学习能扩展到多远，如果我们不构建它，谁会知道呢，我们永远不会知道。

cues.en: This is one of those, if you build it, will they come?
cues.zh: 这是其中一个，如果你建造它，他们会来吗？

cues.en: Our logic is, if we don't build it, they can't come.
cues.zh: 我们的逻辑是，如果我们不构建它，他们就不能来。

cues.en: And so we dedicated ourselves based on first, our first principle beliefs and our analysis, and we got, we got ourselves to the point where we believed this was going to be so effective, and when the company believes something, we should go act on it.
cues.zh: 因此，我们根据我们最初的原则信念和我们的分析，全身心地投入，我们达到了一个点，我们相信这将非常有效，当公司相信某事时，我们就应该采取行动。

cues.en: So we dove deep into deep learning.
cues.zh: 所以我们深入研究了深度学习。

cues.en: And over the next decade, systematically reinvented everything.
cues.zh: 在接下来的十年里，系统地重新发明了所有东西。

cues.en: We reinvented every computing layer.
cues.zh: 我们重新发明了每一个计算层。

cues.en: Starting with the GPU itself, the invention of the modern GPU.
cues.zh: 从GPU本身开始，现代GPU的发明。

cues.en: Which is very different than the GPU of the past that we invented in the first place.
cues.zh: 这与我们最初发明的过去的GPU非常不同。

cues.en: And we went on to invent just about every other aspect of computing, the interconnects, the systems, the networking, and of course, software.
cues.zh: 然后我们继续发明了几乎所有其他计算方面的东西，互连、系统、网络，当然还有软件。

cues.en: We invested billions.
cues.zh: 我们投资了数十亿美元。

cues.en: We invested billions into the unknown.
cues.zh: 我们将数十亿美元投入到未知领域。

cues.en: Thousands of engineers for a decade worked on deep learning and advancing and scaling.
cues.zh: 数千名工程师十年如一日地致力于深度学习的推进和扩展。

cues.en: We invested billions. And we designed and built supercomputers to explore the limits of learning of deep learning and AI.
cues.zh: 我们投入了数十亿美元。我们设计并建造了超级计算机，以探索深度学习和人工智能的学习极限。

cues.en: Then in 2016, we announced DGX-1.
cues.zh: 然后，在2016年，我们发布了DGX-1。

cues.en: Our first AI supercomputer, and I delivered the first one to a startup in San Francisco.
cues.zh: 我们第一台人工智能超级计算机，我将第一台交付给了旧金山的一家初创公司。

cues.en: A startup nobody knew anything about, a collection, a group of friends of mine, who were working on artificial intelligence, a company called OpenAI.
cues.zh: 一家没有人知道的初创公司，一群我的朋友，他们正在从事人工智能工作，一家名为OpenAI的公司。

cues.en: In 2022, 10 years after AlexNet, and about a millionfold increase in computing later.
cues.zh: 2022年，在AlexNet之后十年，计算能力提高了约一百万倍。

cues.en: If you could just imagine, what would it be like if your laptop was a millionfold more capable.
cues.zh: 如果你能想象一下，如果你的笔记本电脑的能力提高一百万倍会是什么样子。

cues.en: A millionfold later, OpenAI launched ChatGPT, and AI went mainstream.
cues.zh: 一百万倍之后，OpenAI发布了ChatGPT，人工智能进入主流。

cues.en: During this decade, Nvidia transformed ourselves from a graphics company that many of you probably first knew us as, that builds GPUs.
cues.zh: 在这十年里，英伟达将自己从一家图形公司转变为一家我们很多人可能最初认识的公司，它制造GPU。

cues.en: To now an AI company that builds massive data center scale supercomputers.
cues.zh: 现在，它已成为一家构建大规模数据中心级超级计算机的人工智能公司。

cues.en: We transformed our company completely.
cues.zh: 我们彻底改变了我们的公司。

cues.en: We also transformed computing completely.
cues.zh: 我们也彻底改变了计算。

cues.en: The fundamental way of doing computing today has been radically changed.
cues.zh: 当今计算的基本方式已经发生了根本性的改变。

cues.en: The computing stack now uses GPU to process large language models that are trained on supercomputers, rather than CPUs that are processing instructions written by programmers.
cues.zh: 计算堆栈现在使用GPU来处理在超级计算机上训练的大型语言模型，而不是处理程序员编写的指令的CPU。

cues.en: We are now creating software that no humans can write.
cues.zh: 我们现在正在创建人类无法编写的软件。

cues.en: We are now creating software that does things that no humans can imagine even just 10 years ago.
cues.zh: 我们现在正在创建一些在十年前人类甚至无法想象的事情的软件。

cues.en: Computers are now intention driven, rather than instruction driven.
cues.zh: 计算机现在是意图驱动的，而不是指令驱动的。

cues.en: Tell computer what you want, and it will figure it out, it will figure out how.
cues.zh: 告诉计算机你想要什么，它会弄清楚，它会弄清楚如何做。

cues.en: And like humans, AI applications will understand the mission, reason, plan, and orchestrate a team of large language models to perform tasks.
cues.zh: 就像人类一样，人工智能应用程序将理解任务，进行推理，制定计划，并协调一个大型语言模型团队来执行任务。

cues.en: Future applications will do and perform very similar to the way we do things, assemble teams of experts, use tools, reason and plan and execute our mission.
cues.zh: 未来的应用程序将以非常类似于我们做事的方式来执行任务，组建专家团队，使用工具，进行推理和计划，并执行我们的任务。

cues.en: Software and what software can do has been completely changed.
cues.zh: 软件以及软件的功能已经完全改变了。

cues.en: Even our industry, as it's being changed and transformed, created yet another industry, an industry the world's never seen before.
cues.zh: 即使是我们的行业，在被改变和转型之后，又创造了一个全新的行业，一个世界前所未见的行业。

cues.en: An industry is forming right in front of our, right in front of our eyes.
cues.zh: 一个行业正在我们眼前形成。

cues.en: AI's input and output are tokens.
cues.zh: 人工智能的输入和输出是令牌。

cues.en: For all the engineers in the room, you know what I mean.
cues.zh: 在座的各位工程师都明白我的意思。

cues.en: These are floating point numbers that embed intelligence.
cues.zh: 这些是嵌入智能的浮点数。

cues.en: Companies are now building a new type, a new type of data center that didn't exist before, that specialized in producing intelligence tokens.
cues.zh: 公司现在正在构建一种新型的、以前不存在的数据中心，专门生产智能令牌。

cues.en: Essentially, AI factories.
cues.zh: 本质上，是人工智能工厂。

cues.en: Like AC generators that Nikola Tesla invented of the past industrial revolution, we now have AI token generators.
cues.zh: 就像尼古拉·特斯拉在过去的工业革命中发明的交流发电机一样，我们现在有了人工智能令牌生成器。

cues.en: And they will be the factories of a new industrial revolution.
cues.zh: 它们将成为新工业革命的工厂。

cues.en: There's large industries producing energy, electricity.
cues.zh: 有大型产业生产能源，电力。

cues.en: We now have a large industry producing something invisible called software.
cues.zh: 我们现在有一个大型产业生产一种看不见的东西，叫做软件。

cues.en: And in the future, in the very near future, we'll have industries that are producing, manufacturing intelligence tokens.
cues.zh: 在未来，在不久的将来，我们将拥有生产、制造智能令牌的产业。

cues.en: A new computing model has emerged, and a new industry has emerged, all because we reason from first principles, formed our belief about the future, and we acted on them.
cues.zh: 一种新的计算模型已经出现，一种新的行业也已经出现，这一切都是因为我们从第一性原理出发进行推理，形成了对未来的信念，并付诸行动。

cues.en: The next wave of AI is robotics.
cues.zh: 下一波人工智能是机器人技术。

cues.en: Where AI, in addition to a language model, also has a physical world model.
cues.zh: 在那里，人工智能除了语言模型之外，还拥有物理世界模型。

cues.en: We work with hundreds of companies, building robots, robotic vehicles, pick and place arms, humanoid robots, and even entire gigantic warehouses that are robotic.
cues.zh: 我们与数百家公司合作，制造机器人、机器人车辆、拾放臂、人形机器人，甚至完全是机器人的巨型仓库。

cues.en: But unlike our AI factory strategy, and our experience there, which was really formed through reasoning and deliberate action, our robotics journey resulted from a series of setbacks.
cues.zh: 但与我们的人工智能工厂战略以及我们在那里的经验不同，我们的机器人之旅是由一系列挫折造成的，而这些经验是通过推理和深思熟虑的行动形成的。

cues.en: As you know, Nvidia invented the GPU. This was before we invented AI factories.
cues.zh: 众所周知，英伟达发明了 GPU。这在我们发明人工智能工厂之前。

cues.en: Our first great contribution to the computer industry was reinventing computer graphics through programmable shaders.
cues.zh: 我们对计算机行业的第一个重大贡献是通过可编程着色器重新发明了计算机图形学。

cues.en: We invented the GPU and programmable shading in 2000.
cues.zh: 我们在 2000 年发明了 GPU 和可编程着色。

cues.en: We wanted to integrate GPUs into every computer.
cues.zh: 我们希望将 GPU 集成到每台计算机中。

cues.en: And so we started to combine our GPUs with motherboard chips, and we launched a fabulous integrated graphics chip.
cues.zh: 因此，我们开始将我们的 GPU 与主板芯片结合起来，并推出了一款出色的集成图形芯片。

cues.en: At the time for AMD CPUs.
cues.zh: 当时是针对 AMD CPU 的。

cues.en: Our chip set business was an instant success.
cues.zh: 我们的芯片组业务立即取得了成功。

cues.en: I think it went from zero to a billion dollars practically overnight.
cues.zh: 我认为它几乎在一夜之间就从零增长到十亿美元。

cues.en: But then all of a sudden, AMD wanted to control all of the technology in the PC, and we wanted to stay independent.
cues.zh: 但突然之间，AMD 想控制 PC 中的所有技术，而我们想保持独立。

cues.en: So they purchased ATI and no longer needed us.
cues.zh: 所以他们收购了 ATI，不再需要我们了。

cues.en: We turned to Intel.
cues.zh: 我们转向了英特尔。

cues.en: That probably wasn't a great idea.
cues.zh: 那可能不是个好主意。

cues.en: But we turned to Intel.
cues.zh: 但我们转向了英特尔。

cues.en: And negotiated a license to connect to Intel CPUs.
cues.zh: 并谈判获得了连接到英特尔 CPU 的许可。

cues.en: Apple was excited about what we were building and asked us to work on a new computer with them.
cues.zh: 苹果对我们正在构建的东西感到兴奋，并要求我们与他们一起开发一款新电脑。

cues.en: Which became the first MacBook Air.
cues.zh: 这成为了第一款 MacBook Air。

cues.en: Well, Intel saw what happened and decided they didn't want us to do that anymore.
cues.zh: 嗯，英特尔看到了发生的事情，并决定他们不希望我们再这样做。

cues.en: And so they terminated our agreement.
cues.zh: 因此，他们终止了我们的协议。

cues.en: Well, we pivoted again.
cues.zh: 嗯，我们再次调整方向。

cues.en: And this time, we went and licensed ARM.
cues.zh: 这一次，我们去获得了 ARM 的许可。

cues.en: And we built a low power SOC, a mobile SOC.
cues.zh: 我们构建了一个低功耗的 SOC，一个移动 SOC。

cues.en: The world's first SOC that was essentially a computer, a full operating computer, and it was incredible.
cues.zh: 世界上第一个本质上是计算机的 SOC，一个完整的操作系统计算机，它令人难以置信。

cues.en: Our chip excited Google.
cues.zh: 我们的芯片让谷歌兴奋不已。

cues.en: And they asked us to work on a new device with them.
cues.zh: 他们要求我们与他们一起开发一款新设备。

cues.en: Which turned out to have been the Android mobile device.
cues.zh: 结果证明是 Android 移动设备。

cues.en: Well, Qualcomm decided they didn't want us to do that.
cues.zh: 嗯，高通决定他们不希望我们这样做。

cues.en: And so they didn't want us to connect to their modems.
cues.zh: 所以他们不希望我们连接到他们的调制解调器。

cues.en: And it's hard to build a mobile device without being connected to a mobile modem.
cues.zh: 而且，在没有连接到移动调制解调器的情况下，很难制造出移动设备。

cues.en: And there were no other LTE modem companies.
cues.zh: 而且没有其他 LTE 调制解调器公司了。

cues.en: So we had to exit the mobile device market.
cues.zh: 所以我们不得不退出移动设备市场。

cues.en: Well, this happened practically on a year rhythm.
cues.zh: 嗯，这种情况几乎是以一年的周期发生的。

cues.en: And we would build something, it would be incredibly successful, generate enormous amounts of excitement, and then one year later, we were kicked out of those markets.
cues.zh: 我们会构建一些东西，它会非常成功，引起巨大的兴奋，然后一年后，我们就被踢出了那些市场。

cues.en: Well, with no more markets to turn to, we decided to build something where we are sure there are no customers.
cues.zh: 嗯，在没有更多市场可去的情况下，我们决定构建一些我们确信没有客户的东西。

cues.en: Because one of the things you can definitely guarantee is where there are no customers, there are also no competitors.
cues.zh: 因为你可以肯定保证的一件事是，没有客户的地方，也没有竞争对手。

cues.en: And nobody cares about you.
cues.zh: 而且没有人关心你。

cues.en: And so we chose a market with no customers, a $0 billion market.
cues.zh: 所以我们选择了一个没有客户的市场，一个零十亿美元的市场。

cues.en: And it was robotics.
cues.zh: 那就是机器人。

cues.en: We built the world's first robotics computer,
cues.zh: 我们构建了世界上第一台机器人计算机，

cues.en: processing an algorithm nobody understood at the time called deep learning.
cues.zh: 处理一个当时没人理解的算法，叫做深度学习。

cues.en: This is over 10 years ago now.
cues.zh: 这已经是十多年前了。

cues.en: 10 years later, I can't be happier with what we've built.
cues.zh: 十年后，我对我所构建的东西感到无比高兴。

cues.en: And the opportunity to create the next wave of AI.
cues.zh: 以及创造下一波人工智能的机会。

cues.en: More importantly, we developed agility and a culture of resilience.
cues.zh: 更重要的是，我们培养了敏捷性和韧性文化。

cues.en: One setback after another, we shook it off and skated to the next opportunity.
cues.zh: 一次又一次的挫折，我们摆脱了它们，然后滑向下一个机会。

cues.en: Each time, we gained skills and strengthened our character.
cues.zh: 每一次，我们都获得了技能，并加强了我们的品格。

cues.en: We strengthened our corporate character.
cues.zh: 我们加强了我们的企业品格。

cues.en: Our company is really hard to distract and really hard to discourage.
cues.zh: 我们的公司很难被分散注意力，也很难被劝退。

cues.en: And no setback, no setback that comes our way, doesn't look like an opportunity these days.
cues.zh: 而且如今，没有一个挫折，没有一个来到我们面前的挫折，看起来不像一个机会。

cues.en: Ironically, the robotics computer that we built today doesn't even need graphics.
cues.zh: 讽刺的是，我们今天建造的机器人计算机甚至不需要图形。

cues.en: Which is why our journey started in the first place.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么我们的旅程一开始就启动了。

cues.en: So where we are today tells us something and teaches us something.
cues.zh: 所以我们今天所处的位置告诉我们一些事情，也教会我们一些事情。

cues.en: The world is uncertain, as Richard Feynman would say.
cues.zh: 世界是不确定的，正如理查德·费曼会说的。

cues.en: And the world can be unfair and deal with deal you with tough cards.
cues.zh: 世界可能是不公平的，并且会给你发艰难的牌。

cues.en: Swiftly, shake it off.
cues.zh: 迅速地，摆脱它。

cues.en: You've apparently been paying too much attention to your books.
cues.zh: 你显然太关注你的书了。

cues.en: Swiftly shake it off.
cues.zh: 迅速地摆脱它。

cues.en: Come on.
cues.zh: 来吧。

cues.en: That's pretty clever.
cues.zh: 那很聪明。

cues.en: I made myself I made myself laugh.
cues.zh: 我让自己，我让自己笑了。

cues.en: There's another opportunity out there, or create one.
cues.zh: 外面还有另一个机会，或者创造一个。

cues.en: Let me tell you one more story.
cues.zh: 让我再讲一个故事。

cues.en: I used to work from one of our international sites for one month each summer.
cues.zh: 我曾经每个夏天在一个国际站点工作一个月。

cues.en: When our kids were in their teens, we spent a summer in Japan.
cues.zh: 当我们的孩子十几岁时，我们在日本度过了一个夏天。

cues.en: Over a weekend, we visited Kyoto and the Silver Temple.
cues.zh: 周末，我们参观了京都和银阁寺。

cues.en: If you haven't had a chance to go, you must.
cues.zh: 如果你还没有机会去，你一定要去。

cues.en: It's renowned for its exquisite moss garden.
cues.zh: 它以其精致的苔藓花园而闻名。

cues.en: The day we visited was quintessential Kyoto summer day.
cues.zh: 我们参观的那天是典型的京都夏日。

cues.en: Suffocatingly, suffocatingly hot and humid, sticky.
cues.zh: 令人窒息的，令人窒息的热和潮湿，粘腻。

cues.en: Heat is radiating radiating from the ground.
cues.zh: 热量从地面辐射，辐射。

cues.en: The air was thick, still.
cues.zh: 空气浓稠，静止。

cues.en: Along with the other tourists, we wandered through the meticulously groomed moss garden.
cues.zh: 和其他游客一起，我们在精心打理的苔藓花园里漫步。

cues.en: And I noticed the lone gardener.
cues.zh: 我注意到了一位孤独的园丁。

cues.en: Now remember, the moss garden, this is the Silver Temple, the moss garden is gigantic.
cues.zh: 现在请记住，苔藓花园，这是银阁寺，苔藓花园非常巨大。

cues.en: It's about it's about the size of this courtyard.
cues.zh: 它大约，它大约是这个庭院的大小。

cues.en: And has the collection, the largest collection of just about every, apparently, every species of moss in the world.
cues.zh: 它拥有收集，最大的收集，几乎所有，显然，世界上所有种类的苔藓。

cues.en: And it's just exquisitely maintained.
cues.zh: 而且它维护得非常精致。

cues.en: I noticed the lone gardener squatting,
cues.zh: 我注意到一位孤独的园丁蹲着，

cues.en: carefully picking at the moss with a bamboo tweezer.
cues.zh: 用竹镊子小心翼翼地挑选苔藓。

cues.en: And putting it in the bamboo basket.
cues.zh: 然后把它放进竹篮里。

cues.en: And I, you have to,
cues.zh: 我，你必须，

cues.en: it's a bamboo tweezer, you know.
cues.zh: 那是一把竹镊子，你知道的。

cues.en: And this is, there's, it's just this one gardener.
cues.zh: 而且这是，有，只有这一个园丁。

cues.en: And the and the basket looked empty.
cues.zh: 而且那个，而且那个篮子看起来是空的。

cues.en: Um, um, well,
cues.zh: 嗯，嗯，嗯，

cues.en: for a moment there, I thought he was picking imaginary moss into into a pile of imaginary dead moss.
cues.zh: 那一刻，我以为他正在把想象中的苔藓捡进，捡进一堆想象中的枯死的苔藓里。

cues.en: And and so I, I walked up to him,
cues.zh: 所以，我，我走上前去，

cues.en: and I said, what are you doing?
cues.zh: 我说，你在做什么？

cues.en: And and in his English he said I'm picking dead moss.
cues.zh: 然后，他用英语说，我正在捡枯萎的苔藓。

cues.en: I'm taking care of my garden.
cues.zh: 我正在照料我的花园。

cues.en: And I said but your garden is so big.
cues.zh: 我说，但你的花园太大了。

cues.en: And he responded I have cared for my garden for 25 years.
cues.zh: 他回答说，我照料我的花园已经25年了。

cues.en: I have plenty of time.
cues.zh: 我有足够的时间。

cues.en: Well that was one of the one of the most profound learnings I in my life.
cues.zh: 嗯，这是我一生中最深刻的学习之一。

cues.en: And and uh and it really it really taught me something.
cues.zh: 它真的教会了我一些东西。

cues.en: This gardener was has dedicated himself to his craft and doing his life's work.
cues.zh: 这位园丁致力于他的技艺，并做着他毕生的工作。

cues.en: And when you do that, you have plenty of time.
cues.zh: 当你这样做时，你就有足够的时间。

cues.en: I begin each morning, I do I do every single morning exactly the same way.
cues.zh: 我每天早上开始，我每天早上都以完全相同的方式进行。

cues.en: I begin each morning by doing my highest priority work first.
cues.zh: 我每天早上开始时，首先做我最高优先级的任务。

cues.en: I have a very clear priority list and I start from the highest priority work first.
cues.zh: 我有一个非常明确的优先事项列表，我首先从最高优先级的任务开始。

cues.en: Before I even get to work, my day is already a success.
cues.zh: 在我开始工作之前，我的一天就已经成功了。

cues.en: I've already completed my most important work and can dedicate my day to helping others.
cues.zh: 我已经完成了我最重要的工作，并且可以把我的时间奉献给帮助他人。

cues.en: And when people apologize for interrupting me, I always say:
cues.zh: 当人们为打断我而道歉时，我总是说：

cues.en: I have plenty of time.
cues.zh: 我有足够的时间。

cues.en: And I do.
cues.zh: 而且我确实有。

cues.en: Graduates of the class of 2024.
cues.zh: 2024届毕业生。

cues.en: I can hardly imagine anyone more prepared for the future than you.
cues.zh: 我很难想象还有谁比你们更准备好迎接未来。

cues.en: You dedicated yourself, you worked hard, you earned a world class education from one of the most prestigious schools in the world.
cues.zh: 你们奉献了自己，努力工作，在世界上最负盛名的学校之一获得了世界一流的教育。

cues.en: And as you commence into the next stage, take my learnings.
cues.zh: 当你们进入下一阶段时，请接受我的经验教训。

cues.en: And hopefully they'll help you along the way.
cues.zh: 希望它们能一路帮助你们。

cues.en: I hope you believe in something, something unconventional, something unexplored.
cues.zh: 我希望你们相信某件事，某件非传统的事，某件未被探索的事。

cues.en: But let it be informed and let it be reasoned.
cues.zh: 但要让它有依据，让它合乎情理。

cues.en: Then dedicate yourself to making it happen.
cues.zh: 然后，致力于让它发生。

cues.en: You may find your GPU.
cues.zh: 你们可能会找到你们的GPU。

cues.en: You may find your CUDA.
cues.zh: 你们可能会找到你们的CUDA。

cues.en: You may find your generative AI.
cues.zh: 你们可能会找到你们的生成式AI。

cues.en: You may find your Nvidia.
cues.zh: 你们可能会找到你们的Nvidia。

cues.en: I hope you will see setbacks as new opportunities.
cues.zh: 我希望你们能把挫折看作新的机会。

cues.en: Your pain and suffering will strengthen your character, your resilience and agility.
cues.zh: 你们的痛苦和磨难将增强你们的品格、韧性和敏捷性。

cues.en: And they are the ultimate superpowers.
cues.zh: 它们是终极的超能力。

cues.en: Of all of the things that I value most about my abilities, intelligence is not top of that list.
cues.zh: 在我所有珍视的能力中，智力并非名列前茅。

cues.en: My ability to endure pain and suffering.
cues.zh: 我忍受痛苦和磨难的能力。

cues.en: My ability to work on something for a very, very long period of time.
cues.zh: 我长时间从事某项工作的能力。

cues.en: My ability to handle setbacks and see the opportunities just around the corner, I consider to be my superpowers.
cues.zh: 我处理挫折并在拐角处看到机会的能力，我认为是我的超能力。

cues.en: And I hope they're yours.
cues.zh: 我希望它们也是你们的。

cues.en: And I hope you find a craft.
cues.zh: 我希望你们能找到一门手艺。

cues.en: I hope you find a craft.
cues.zh: 我希望你们能找到一门手艺。

cues.en: It's not important to decide on day one. It's not even important to decide anytime soon.
cues.zh: 第一天就决定并不重要。任何时候很快决定也不重要。

cues.en: But I hope you do find a craft.
cues.zh: 但我希望你们能找到一门手艺。

cues.en: That you want to dedicate your lifetime to perfecting.
cues.zh: 你们想用一生去完善它。

cues.en: To hone the skills of.
cues.zh: 磨练技能。

cues.en: And let it be your life's work.
cues.zh: 让它成为你们毕生的事业。

cues.en: And then lastly, prioritize your life.
cues.zh: 最后，请优先考虑你们的生活。

cues.en: There's so many things going on, there's so many things to do.
cues.zh: 有很多事情在发生，有很多事情要做。

cues.en: But prioritize your life and you will have plenty of time to do the important things.
cues.zh: 但请优先考虑你们的生活，你们将有足够的时间去做重要的事情。

cues.en: Congratulations, class of 2024. Go get them!
cues.zh: 祝贺你们，2024届毕业生。去争取吧！

material.title: 丹泽尔·华盛顿 · 2011 宾大毕业演讲
material.subtitle: 英文原声 · 双语字幕 · 完整演讲

cues.en: Please join me in welcoming Denzel Washington.
cues.zh: 请加入我，欢迎丹泽尔·华盛顿。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢。

cues.en: Um, I am obviously the most unorganized. Everybody else has nice boxes to bring their script up in and I just like kind of got it all messed up here and put it inside of a magazine, so.
cues.zh: 嗯，我显然是最没条理的。其他人都有漂亮的盒子来放他们的剧本，而我只是把它弄得一团糟，塞进了一本杂志里，所以。

cues.en: So, in fact, I don't even have it in the right order. Wait a minute. Let me get in the right order here.
cues.zh: 所以，事实上，我甚至都没有按正确的顺序排列。等一下。让我把它按正确的顺序排列好。

cues.en: So if it start to like flying around the stage, just, you know, run around and grab it for me and bring it back up here for me. I'll keep going as I can.
cues.zh: 所以如果它开始在舞台上乱飞，你就，你知道，跑过去帮我捡起来，然后把它拿回这里给我。我会继续进行下去。

cues.en: President Gutman,
cues.zh: 古特曼总统，

cues.en: Provost Price,
cues.zh: 教务长普莱斯，

cues.en: Board Chair Cohen,
cues.zh: 董事会主席科恩，

cues.en: Fellow honorees.
cues.zh: 各位获奖者。

cues.en: Beautiful honorees.
cues.zh: 美丽的获奖者。

cues.en: And today's graduates.
cues.zh: 以及今天的毕业生。

cues.en: I'm, I'm honored and grateful for the invitation today.
cues.zh: 我，我今天很荣幸也很感激收到邀请。

cues.en: It's always been great to be on the Penn campus.
cues.zh: 能在宾夕法尼亚大学校园里一直很棒。

cues.en: I've been here before a lot of times for basketball games, my son played at the Palestra, played on the basketball team.
cues.zh: 我以前来过很多次看篮球比赛，我儿子曾在帕莱斯特拉打球，打过篮球队。

cues.en: I, yeah, that's right.
cues.zh: 我，是的，没错。

cues.en: Played on the basketball team.
cues.zh: 打过篮球队。

cues.en: Coach didn't give him enough playing time.
cues.zh: 教练没给他足够的时间。

cues.en: We'll talk about that later.
cues.zh: 我们稍后会谈论这个。

cues.en: No, but I'm really, I'm really, I'm really pleased with the progress that Coach Allen has made and.
cues.zh: 不，但我真的很，我真的很，我真的很满意艾伦教练取得的进步，而且。

cues.en: No, I do. I am. I really am.
cues.zh: 不，我确实。我是。我真的如此。

cues.en: And, uh, I hope him the best success in the future.
cues.zh: 而且，呃，我希望他未来取得最好的成功。

cues.en: And and you know, I always get a warm welcome when I come to Pennsylvania, when I come to Philadelphia.
cues.zh: 而且你知道，当我来到宾夕法尼亚州，来到费城时，我总是受到热烈欢迎。

cues.en: Uh, except on the few occasions where I wear my Yankee cap.
cues.zh: 呃，除了少数几次我戴着我的洋基队帽子。

cues.en: I mean, what was wrong with that?
cues.zh: 我是说，那有什么问题吗？

cues.en: I can't suddenly just switch up and wear a Philly cap. I mean, I mean, it's like taking your life in your hands around here when you wear a Yankee cap.
cues.zh: 我不能突然就换上费城队的帽子。我是说，我是说，当你戴着洋基队帽子在这里走动时，就像把自己的生命置于危险之中。

cues.en: I'm telling you.
cues.zh: 我告诉你。

cues.en: I met a couple of guys and they were like, hey, we love you Denzel, but, you know, you walking around with that hat on.
cues.zh: 我遇到过几个人，他们说，嘿，我们爱你丹泽尔，但是，你知道，你戴着那顶帽子到处走。

cues.en: We don't care who you are.
cues.zh: 我们不在乎你是谁。

cues.en: So you, be happy to see that I'm not wearing my Yankee cap today.
cues.zh: 所以你，很高兴看到我今天没有戴我的洋基队帽子。

cues.en: And I'm wearing my Yankee socks, my Yankee t-shirt, my Yankee jock shorts, and Yankee underwear, my Yankee toe warmers, but.
cues.zh: 我穿着我的洋基队袜子，我的洋基队T恤，我的洋基队运动短裤，还有洋基队内裤，我的洋基队脚趾保暖袜，但是。

cues.en: Not my Yankee cap.
cues.zh: 不是我的洋基队帽子。

cues.en: But still, I'll be honest with you. I'm, I'm, I'm a little nervous.
cues.zh: 但仍然，我会对你说实话。我，我，我有点紧张。

cues.en: I'm, I'm not used to speaking at a graduation of this magnitude. It's, it's a little overwhelming.
cues.zh: 我，我不习惯在如此规模的毕业典礼上发表演讲。这，这有点令人不知所措。

cues.en: It's out of my comfort zone.
cues.zh: 这超出了我的舒适区。

cues.en: You dress me up in army fatigues or throw me on top of a moving train, someone say unstoppable or ask me to play Malcolm X, Ruben Hurricane Carter or Alonzo from Training Day.
cues.zh: 你给我穿上军装，或者把我扔到一列飞驰的火车上，有人说势不可挡，或者让我扮演马尔科姆·X、鲁宾·卡特或《训练日》中的阿隆佐。我都可以做到。

cues.en: I can do that.
cues.zh: 我都可以做到。

cues.en: But a commencement speech, it's a very serious affair and it's a very different ball game.
cues.zh: 但毕业典礼演讲，这是一件非常严肃的事情，而且是一场完全不同的比赛。

cues.en: There are literally thousands and thousands of people here.
cues.zh: 这里有成千上万的人。

cues.en: And for those who say, well, you're a movie star, means that people watch you and watch you speak all the time. Well, that's true.
cues.zh: 对于那些说，嗯，你是个电影明星，这意味着人们一直在看你，看你说话。嗯，那是真的。

cues.en: That that's technically true.
cues.zh: 那，那技术上是真的。

cues.en: But I'm not actually in the theater watching them watching me.
cues.zh: 但我实际上并不在电影院里看着他们看着我。

cues.en: I think that makes sense.
cues.zh: 我想这说得通。

cues.en: I mean, I'm not there when they call for a fidget around or pull out their iPhones or text their boyfriend or scratch their behinds or whatever it is they're doing in the movie theater.
cues.zh: 我是说，当他们发出咯吱声，或者拿出iPhone，或者给男朋友发短信，或者挠痒痒，或者无论他们在电影院里做什么的时候，我都不在那里。

cues.en: But from up here, I can see every single one of you.
cues.zh: 但从这里往上看，我可以看到你们每一个人。

cues.en: And that makes me uncomfortable.
cues.zh: 这让我感到不舒服。

cues.en: So please, don't pull out your iPhones and your texts. Don't text your boyfriend until after I'm done.
cues.zh: 所以请，不要拿出你们的iPhone和你们的短信。在我说完之前，不要给你们的男朋友发短信。

cues.en: If you have to scratch your behind, I mean, I understand, go ahead.
cues.zh: 如果你非要挠挠屁股，我明白，请便。

cues.en: I was thinking about this speech, what I should say.
cues.zh: 我一直在思考这个演讲，我该说些什么。

cues.en: I figured the best way to keep your attention would be to talk about something, you know, really like juicy Hollywood stuff.
cues.zh: 我想保持你们注意力的最好方式就是谈论一些，你知道的，非常八卦的好莱坞的东西。

cues.en: Like, I thought I could talk about, uh, me and Russell Crowe getting in arguments on the set of American gangster or, uh...
cues.zh: 比如，我想我可以谈谈，呃，我和罗素·克劳在《美国黑帮》片场争吵的事情，或者，呃...

cues.en: But I said, no, no, no, you're a group of high-minded intellectuals, you're not interested in that.
cues.zh: 但我想，不，不，不，你们是一群思想高尚的知识分子，你们对此不感兴趣。

cues.en: Or maybe not.
cues.zh: 或者也许不是。

cues.en: I thought about, uh, a private moment I had, uh, backstage with Angelina Jolie in a dressing room.
cues.zh: 我想了想，呃，我在后台化妆间和安吉丽娜·朱莉共处的私密时刻。

cues.en: After the Oscars.
cues.zh: 在奥斯卡颁奖典礼之后。

cues.en: But I said, no, I don't think so. This is an Ivy League school, and I mean...
cues.zh: 但我想，不，我不这么认为。这是一所常春藤盟校，我的意思是...

cues.en: Angelina Jolie, had naked in a dressing room. Who wants to hear about that?
cues.zh: 安吉丽娜·朱莉，在化妆间里裸体。谁想听那个？

cues.en: No one. No one. No one. No one.
cues.zh: 没人。没人。没人。没人。

cues.en: This is Penn. That stuff would never go over well over here.
cues.zh: 这是宾夕法尼亚大学。那些东西在这里永远不会受欢迎。

cues.en: Maybe a Drezell, but not over here.
cues.zh: 也许德雷塞尔大学可以，但这里不行。

cues.en: I'm in trouble now.
cues.zh: 我现在有麻烦了。

cues.en: So I was back to square one, feeling the pressure.
cues.zh: 所以我又回到了原点，感受到了压力。

cues.en: So now you're probably thinking, if it was going to be this difficult, this much pressure, why did I even accept today's invitation in the first place?
cues.zh: 所以现在你可能在想，如果会这么困难，这么有压力，我当初为什么还要接受今天的邀请？

cues.en: Well, you know, my son goes here. That's number one.
cues.zh: 嗯，你知道，我儿子在这儿上学。这是第一点。

cues.en: That's a good reason.
cues.zh: 这是个好理由。

cues.en: And I always like to check to see how my money's being spent.
cues.zh: 而且我总是想看看我的钱是怎么花的。

cues.en: And I'm sure there's some parents out there who can relate to what I'm talking about.
cues.zh: 我敢肯定有些家长能理解我在说什么。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: To everybody upstairs.
cues.zh: 给楼上的各位。

cues.en: And there were some other good reasons for me to show up.
cues.zh: 还有一些其他的好理由让我出席。

cues.en: Sure, I got an Academy Award, but I never had something called a magic meatball after waiting in line for half an hour at the food truck.
cues.zh: 当然，我获得过奥斯卡奖，但我从未在餐车前排了半小时的队后吃到过所谓的“魔法肉丸”。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: Yes, I talked face to face with President Obama, but I never talked face to face with a guy named Quiter.
cues.zh: 是的，我曾与奥巴马总统面对面交谈，但我从未与一个叫奎特的人面对面交谈过。

cues.en: Who sings bad songs over at Smokes on Tuesday night.
cues.zh: 他在周二晚上在Smokes唱难听的歌。

cues.en: I've never been to Belize. I've never been to the Hemo.
cues.zh: 我从未去过伯利兹。我从未去过Hemo。

cues.en: Yes, I have played a detective who battles demons, but I've never been to a school in my life where the squirrel population has gone bananas.
cues.zh: 是的，我扮演过与恶魔搏斗的侦探，但我一生中从未去过一个松鼠数量已经疯了的学校。

cues.en: I mean, they're breaking in the dorm rooms, they're walking around campus. I think I saw some carrying books on their way to class.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，它们闯进宿舍，在校园里走动。我想我看到一些在去上课的路上还带着书。

cues.en: So I had to be here.
cues.zh: 所以我必须来这里。

cues.en: I had to come.
cues.zh: 我必须来。

cues.en: Even though I was afraid I might make a fool of myself.
cues.zh: 即使我害怕我可能会出丑。

cues.en: In fact, if you really want to know the truth, I had to come exactly because I had to come exactly because I might make a fool of myself.
cues.zh: 事实上，如果你真的想知道真相，我必须来，正是因为我必须来，正是因为我可能会出丑。

cues.en: Now, what am I talking about? Here it is.
cues.zh: 现在，我在说什么？就是这个。

cues.en: I found that nothing in life is worthwhile unless you take risks. Nothing.
cues.zh: 我发现生活中没有什么是有价值的，除非你冒险。什么都没有。

cues.en: Nelson Mandela said, there is no passion to be found playing small, in settling for a life that's less than the one you're capable of living.
cues.zh: 纳尔逊·曼德拉说，在碌碌无为中找不到激情，在满足于一种低于你能力的生活中找不到激情。

cues.en: Now, I'm sure in your experiences in school and applying to college and picking your major and deciding what you want to do with life, I'm sure people have told you to make sure you have something to fall back on.
cues.zh: 现在，我敢肯定，在你上学、申请大学、选择专业、决定人生道路的经历中，我敢肯定人们都告诉过你要确保有后路。

cues.en: Make sure you got something to fall back on, honey.
cues.zh: 确保你有所依靠，亲爱的。

cues.en: But I never understood that concept, having something to fall back on.
cues.zh: 但我从未理解过那个概念，有所依靠。

cues.en: If I'm going to fall, I don't want to fall back on anything.
cues.zh: 如果我要跌倒，我不想依靠任何东西。

cues.en: Except my faith.
cues.zh: 除了我的信仰。

cues.en: I want to fall forward.
cues.zh: 我想向前跌倒。

cues.en: I figure at least this way I'll see what I'm going to hit.
cues.zh: 我想至少这样我能看到我要撞到什么。

cues.en: Fall forward.
cues.zh: 向前跌倒。

cues.en: This is what I mean.
cues.zh: 这就是我的意思。

cues.en: Reggie Jackson struck out 2,600 times in his career, the most in the history of baseball.
cues.zh: 雷吉·杰克逊在他的职业生涯中被三振了2600次，是棒球历史上最多的。

cues.en: But you don't hear about the strikeouts. People remember the home runs.
cues.zh: 但你没听说过那些被三振的事。人们记得那些本垒打。

cues.en: Fall forward.
cues.zh: 向前跌倒。

cues.en: Thomas Edison conducted 1,000 failed experiments. Did you know that? I didn't know that.
cues.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生进行了1000次失败的实验。你知道吗？我不知道。

cues.en: Because the 1,000 and first was the light bulb.
cues.zh: 因为第1001次是灯泡。

cues.en: Fall forward.
cues.zh: 向前跌倒。

cues.en: Every failed experiment is one step closer to success.
cues.zh: 每一次失败的实验都离成功更近一步。

cues.en: You've got to take risks, and I'm sure you've probably heard that before.
cues.zh: 你必须冒险，我敢肯定你以前可能听过这句话。

cues.en: But I want to talk to you about why that's so important.
cues.zh: 但我想和你谈谈为什么这如此重要。

cues.en: I got three reasons, and and you can pick up your iPhones.
cues.zh: 我有三个原因，你可以拿出你的iPhone了。

cues.en: First, you will fail at some point in your life. Accept it.
cues.zh: 首先，你会在生活中某个时候失败。接受它。

cues.en: You will lose. You will embarrass yourself.
cues.zh: 你会输。你会让自己难堪。

cues.en: You will suck at something.
cues.zh: 你会在某方面很糟糕。

cues.en: There's no doubt about it.
cues.zh: 毫无疑问。

cues.en: And I know that's probably not a traditional message for a graduation ceremony, but hey.
cues.zh: 我知道这可能不是毕业典礼上的传统信息，但嘿。

cues.en: I'm telling you.
cues.zh: 我告诉你。

cues.en: Embrace it.
cues.zh: 拥抱它。

cues.en: Because it's inevitable.
cues.zh: 因为它不可避免。

cues.en: And I should know.
cues.zh: 我应该知道。

cues.en: In the acting business, you fail all the time. Early on in my career,
cues.zh: 在演艺界，你总是失败。在我职业生涯的早期，

cues.en: I auditioned for a part in a Broadway musical. Perfect role for me, I thought.
cues.zh: 我试镜了一个百老汇音乐剧的角色。我认为这是个完美适合我的角色。

cues.en: Except for the fact that I can't sing.
cues.zh: 除了我不会唱歌这一点。

cues.en: So, I'm I'm in the wings.
cues.zh: 所以，我在后台。

cues.en: I'm about to go on stage, but the guy in front of me,
cues.zh: 我即将上台，但排在我前面的人，

cues.en: he's singing like, like, like Pavarotti. He's just...
cues.zh: 他唱得像，像，像帕瓦罗蒂一样。他只是...

cues.en: And he's just going on and on and on, and I'm just shrinking. I'm getting smaller and smaller.
cues.zh: 他唱个没完没了，而我只是在萎缩。我变得越来越小。

cues.en: So they say, oh, thank you very much, thank you very much, and, and you'll be hearing from us.
cues.zh: 所以他们说，哦，非常感谢，非常感谢，然后，然后我们会联系你。

cues.en: So I come out with my little sheet music and it was, it was, uh, just my imagination by the temptations.
cues.zh: 所以我拿着我的小乐谱走出来，那是，那是，呃， Temptations 乐队的《Just My Imagination》。

cues.en: That's what I came up with.
cues.zh: 这就是我想到的。

cues.en: So I hand it to the, the, the accompanist, and she looks at it and looks at me and looks at the director and was like,
cues.zh: 所以我把它递给，递给，递给伴奏者，她看了看，看了看我，又看了看导演，然后说，

cues.en: Nice.
cues.zh: 不错。

cues.en: So I start, you know, I'm going to sing.
cues.zh: 所以我开始，你知道，我要唱歌了。

cues.en: It's just my imagination. Once again, and then...
cues.zh: 这只是我的想象。再一次，然后...

cues.en: kind of away with me. And then I'm not singing anything.
cues.zh: 有点离谱。然后我什么都没唱。

cues.en: So I'm thinking, I'm getting better. I start getting into it.
cues.zh: 所以我心想，我越来越好了。我开始进入状态了。

cues.en: I think, thank you. Thank you. Thank you very much, Mr. Washington. Thank you.
cues.zh: 我想，谢谢。谢谢。非常感谢，华盛顿先生。谢谢。

cues.en: So I soon that I didn't get the job.
cues.zh: 所以很快我就知道我没得到这份工作。

cues.en: But the next part of the audition, he called me back. The next part of the audition
cues.zh: 但试镜的下一部分，他叫我回去。试镜的下一部分

cues.en: is the acting part of the audition.
cues.zh: 是试镜的表演部分。

cues.en: And I'm like, hey, okay, maybe I can't sing, but I know I can act.
cues.zh: 我想，嘿，好吧，也许我不会唱歌，但我知道我能演。

cues.en: So they pair me with this guy, and again, I didn't know about musical theater.
cues.zh: 所以他们把我跟一个家伙配对，我又不知道音乐剧。

cues.en: And musical theater is big, so they can reach everyone all the way in the back
cues.zh: 音乐剧的舞台很大，所以他们能让后面所有人都看到

cues.en: of the stadium.
cues.zh: 的观众。

cues.en: And I'm more from the realistic, naturalistic kind of acting where you, you know,
cues.zh: 而我更擅长写实、自然主义的表演，在那里你，你知道，

cues.en: you actually talk to the person next to you.
cues.zh: 你实际上是和旁边的人说话。

cues.en: So I, I don't know what my line was. My line was, well,
cues.zh: 所以，我，我不知道我的台词是什么。我的台词是，嗯，

cues.en: hand me the cup.
cues.zh: 把杯子递给我。

cues.en: And his line was, well, I will hand you the cup, my dear. The cup will be there to be handed to you.
cues.zh: 他的台词是，嗯，我会把杯子递给你，亲爱的。杯子会在那里等你递给你。

cues.en: I say, okay.
cues.zh: 我说，好吧。

cues.en: Well, should I give you the cup back?
cues.zh: 嗯，我应该把杯子还给你吗？

cues.en: Oh, yes, you should give it back to me because you know that is my cup and it should be given back to me.
cues.zh: 哦，是的，你应该把它还给我，因为你知道那是我的杯子，它应该还给我。

cues.en: I didn't get the job.
cues.zh: 我没得到这份工作。

cues.en: But here's the thing.
cues.zh: 但关键是。

cues.en: I didn't quit.
cues.zh: 我没有放弃。

cues.en: I didn't fall back.
cues.zh: 我没有退缩。

cues.en: I walked out of there to prepare for the next audition, and the next audition, and the next audition.
cues.zh: 我走出那里，为下一次试镜，再下一次试镜，再下一次试镜做准备。

cues.en: I prayed.
cues.zh: 我祈祷了。

cues.en: I prayed and I prayed.
cues.zh: 我祈祷了又祈祷。

cues.en: But I continued to fail and fail and fail.
cues.zh: 但我一直失败，失败，再失败。

cues.en: But it didn't matter because you know what?
cues.zh: 但那并不重要，因为你知道吗？

cues.en: There's an old saying: You hang around the barber shop long enough, sooner or later you're going to get a haircut.
cues.zh: 有句老话：你在理发店待得够久，迟早会理发。

cues.en: So you will catch a break and I did catch a break.
cues.zh: 所以你会抓住机会，我也抓住了机会。

cues.en: Last year, I did a play called Fences on Broadway.
cues.zh: 去年，我演了一部叫《栅栏》的百老汇戏剧。

cues.en: As someone talked about it.
cues.zh: 有人谈论过它。

cues.en: Won the Tony Award.
cues.zh: 赢得了托尼奖。

cues.en: And I didn't have to sing, by the way.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，我不用唱歌。

cues.en: But here's the kicker.
cues.zh: 但关键来了。

cues.en: It was at the Court Theatre.
cues.zh: 那是在法院剧院。

cues.en: It was at the same theatre that I failed that first audition 30 years prior.
cues.zh: 那是我30年前第一次试镜失败的同一个剧院。

cues.en: The point is, and I'll pick up the pace.
cues.zh: 重点是，我将加快节奏。

cues.en: The point is, every graduate here today has the training and the talent to succeed.
cues.zh: 重点是，今天这里的每一位毕业生都拥有成功的培训和才能。

cues.en: But do you have the guts to fail?
cues.zh: 但你有失败的勇气吗？

cues.en: Here's my second point about failure.
cues.zh: 这是我关于失败的第二点。

cues.en: If you don't fail, you're not even trying.
cues.zh: 如果你不失败，你就根本没有尝试。

cues.en: I'll say it again.
cues.zh: 我再说一遍。

cues.en: If you don't fail, you're not even trying.
cues.zh: 如果你不失败，你就根本没有尝试。

cues.en: My wife told me this great expression: To get something you never had, you have to do something you never did.
cues.zh: 我妻子告诉我一个很棒的说法：要想得到你从未拥有的东西，你必须做你从未做过的事情。

cues.en: Les Brown's a motivational speaker, he made an analogy about this.
cues.zh: 莱斯·布朗是一位励志演说家，他对此做了一个类比。

cues.en: He says, imagine you're on your deathbed and standing around your deathbed are the ghosts representing your unfulfilled potential.
cues.zh: 他说，想象一下你躺在临终床上，床边站着代表你未实现潜力的鬼魂。

cues.en: The ghost of the ideas you never acted on, the ghost of the talents you didn't use.
cues.zh: 那些你从未付诸行动的创意的鬼魂，那些你未曾使用的才华的鬼魂。

cues.en: And they're standing around your bed, angry, disappointed and upset.
cues.zh: 他们围着你的床站着，愤怒、失望和沮丧。

cues.en: They say, we came to you because you could have brought us to life, they say.
cues.zh: 他们说，我们来到你这里，因为你本可以让我们活过来，他们说。

cues.en: And now we have to go to the grave together.
cues.zh: 现在我们必须一起下葬。

cues.en: So I ask you today:
cues.zh: 所以今天我问你：

cues.en: How many ghosts are going to be around your bed when your time comes?
cues.zh: 当你的时刻来临时，会有多少鬼魂围在你的床边？

cues.en: You've invested, you've invested a lot in your education and people have invested in you.
cues.zh: 你已经投入了，你为你的教育投入了很多，人们也为你投入了。

cues.en: And let me tell you, the world needs your talents, man, does it ever.
cues.zh: 让我告诉你，世界需要你的才华，天哪，确实需要。

cues.en: I just got back from Africa like two days ago, so if I'm rambling on, it's because I'm jet-lagged.
cues.zh: 我大概两天前刚从非洲回来，所以如果我语无伦次，那是因为我有时差。

cues.en: I just got back from South Africa, it's a beautiful country.
cues.zh: 我刚从南非回来，那是一个美丽的国家。

cues.en: But there are places there with terrible poverty that need help.
cues.zh: 但那里有些地方有可怕的贫困需要帮助。

cues.en: And Africa is just the tip of the iceberg.
cues.zh: 而非洲只是冰山一角。

cues.en: The Middle East needs your help.
cues.zh: 中东需要你的帮助。

cues.en: Japan needs your help.
cues.zh: 日本需要你的帮助。

cues.en: Alabama needs your help.
cues.zh: 阿拉巴马需要你的帮助。

cues.en: Tennessee needs your help.
cues.zh: 田纳西需要你的帮助。

cues.en: Louisiana needs your help.
cues.zh: 路易斯安那需要你的帮助。

cues.en: Philadelphia needs your help.
cues.zh: 费城需要你的帮助。

cues.en: The world needs a lot and we need it from you.
cues.zh: 世界需要很多，而我们需要你。

cues.en: We really do.
cues.zh: 我们确实需要。

cues.en: We need it from you young people. I mean, I'm not speaking for the rest of us up here, but I know I'm getting a little gray.
cues.zh: 我们需要你们年轻人。我的意思是，我不是代表我们这里其他人说话，但我知道我有点老了。

cues.en: We need it from you, the young people, because remember this.
cues.zh: 我们需要你们，年轻人，因为请记住这一点。

cues.en: So you got to get out there.
cues.zh: 所以你必须走出去。

cues.en: You got to give it everything you got, whether it's your time,
cues.zh: 你必须全力以赴，无论是你的时间，

cues.en: your, your, your talent,
cues.zh: 你的，你的，你的才华，

cues.en: your prayers,
cues.zh: 你的祈祷，

cues.en: or your treasures.
cues.zh: 还是你的财富。

cues.en: Because remember this:
cues.zh: 因为请记住这一点：

cues.en: You will never see a U-Haul behind a hearse.
cues.zh: 你永远不会在灵车后面看到一辆U-Haul。

cues.en: I'll say it again.
cues.zh: 我再说一遍。

cues.en: You will never see a U-Haul behind a hearse.
cues.zh: 你永远不会在灵车后面看到一辆U-Haul。

cues.en: You can't take it with you.
cues.zh: 你带不走它。

cues.en: The Egyptians tried it.
cues.zh: 埃及人试过了。

cues.en: And all they got was robbed.
cues.zh: 他们只被抢劫了。

cues.en: So the question is:
cues.zh: 所以问题是：

cues.en: What are you going to do with what you have?
cues.zh: 你打算用你拥有的东西做什么？

cues.en: I'm not talking about how much you have.
cues.zh: 我说的不是你拥有多少。

cues.en: Some of you are business majors, some of you are theologians, nurses, sociologists.
cues.zh: 你们中的一些人是商科专业的，一些人是神学家、护士、社会学家。

cues.en: Some of you have money.
cues.zh: 你们中的一些人有钱。

cues.en: Some of you have patience.
cues.zh: 你们中的一些人有耐心。

cues.en: Some of you have kindness.
cues.zh: 你们中的一些人有善良。

cues.en: Alright, now here's my last point about failure. Sometimes it's the best way to figure out where you're going.
cues.zh: 好了，现在是我关于失败的最后一点。有时它是弄清楚你要去哪里的最好方法。

cues.en: Your life will never be a straight path.
cues.zh: 你的人生永远不会是一条笔直的路。

cues.en: I began at Fordham University as a pre-med student. I took a course called the cardiac morphosis. I still can't say it.
cues.zh: 我在福特汉姆大学开始是一名医预科学生。我上了一门课，叫做心脏形态发生。我还是说不出来。

cues.en: Cardiac, cardiac morphogenesis. I couldn't read it, I couldn't say it, I sure couldn't pass it.
cues.zh: 心脏的，心脏形态发生。我读不出来，我说不出来，我肯定考不过。

cues.en: So then I decided to go into pre-law, then journalism.
cues.zh: 于是我决定转学法律预科，然后是新闻学。

cues.en: And with no academic focus, my grades took off in their own direction.
cues.zh: 而且由于没有学术重点，我的成绩朝着自己的方向发展。

cues.en: Yeah, down.
cues.zh: 是的，向下。

cues.en: I was a 1.8 GPA.
cues.zh: 我的平均绩点是1.8。

cues.en: One semester. And the university very politely suggested that it might be better to take some time off.
cues.zh: 一个学期。大学非常礼貌地建议我最好休息一段时间。

cues.en: I was 20 years old. I was at my lowest point.
cues.zh: 我20岁。我跌到了谷底。

cues.en: And then one day, and I remember the exact day, March 27th, 1975. I was helping my mother in her beauty shop. My mother owned a beauty shop up in Mount Vernon.
cues.zh: 然后有一天，我记得确切的日子，1975年3月27日。我在她的美容店里帮我妈妈。我妈妈在弗农山上开了一家美容店。

cues.en: And there was this older woman who was considered one of the elders in the town. And I didn't know her personally, but I was looking in the mirror.
cues.zh: 那里有一位年长的女士，被认为是镇上的长者之一。我不认识她，但我当时正看着镜子。

cues.en: And every time I looked to the mirror, I could see her behind me. And she was staring at me.
cues.zh: 每次我看向镜子，我都能看到她在我身后。她正盯着我。

cues.en: She just kept looking at me. Every time I looked at her, she kept giving me these strange looks.
cues.zh: 她一直看着我。每次我看向她，她都给我奇怪的眼神。

cues.en: So she finally took the dryer off her head and said something, she said something I'll never forget.
cues.zh: 于是她终于摘下了头上的吹风机，说了些话，说了些我永远不会忘记的话。

cues.en: First of all, she said, somebody give me a piece of paper. Give me a piece of paper.
cues.zh: 首先，她说，有人给我一张纸。给我一张纸。

cues.en: She said, young boy, I have a prophecy.
cues.zh: 她说，年轻人，我有一个预言。

cues.en: A spiritual prophecy.
cues.zh: 一个属灵的预言。

cues.en: She said, you are going to travel the world and speak to millions of people.
cues.zh: 她说，你将周游世界，向数百万人发表演讲。

cues.en: Now mind you, I'm 20 years old. I'm flunked out of school. In fact, like a wise ass, I'm thinking to myself, maybe she's got something in that crystal ball about me getting back in the school next fall.
cues.zh: 请注意，我20岁。我被学校开除了。事实上，像个聪明的混蛋一样，我心想，也许她在那个水晶球里看到了我明年秋天重返学校的事情。

cues.en: But maybe she was onto something because later that summer, while working as a counselor at a YMCA camp in Connecticut, we put on a talent show for the campers.
cues.zh: 但也许她是对的，因为那年夏天晚些时候，我在康涅狄格州的一个基督教青年会营地做辅导员时，我们为营员们举办了一个才艺表演。

cues.en: And after the show, another counselor came up to me and asked, have you ever thought about acting? You're good at that.
cues.zh: 表演结束后，另一位辅导员走过来问我，你有没有想过演戏？你很擅长。

cues.en: So when I got back to Fordham that fall, I got in, and I changed my major once again, for the last time.
cues.zh: 所以当那个秋天我回到福特汉姆时，我被录取了，我又一次改变了我的专业，这是最后一次。

cues.en: And in the years that followed, just as that woman prophesied, I have traveled the world and I have spoken to millions of people through my movies.
cues.zh: 在接下来的几年里，正如那位女士预言的那样，我周游了世界，并通过我的电影向数百万人发表演讲。

cues.en: Millions who up until this day couldn't see me. I who up until this day, I couldn't see while I was talking to them. And they couldn't see me. They could only see the movie.
cues.zh: 数百万人直到今天都看不到我。我直到今天都看不到，当我与他们交谈时。他们也看不到我。他们只能看到电影。

cues.en: They couldn't see the real me.
cues.zh: 他们看不到真实的我。

cues.en: But I see you today.
cues.zh: 但我今天看到了你们。

cues.en: And I'm encouraged by what I see.
cues.zh: 我为我所看到的感到鼓舞。

cues.en: And I'm strengthened by what I see.
cues.zh: 我为我所看到的感到振奋。

cues.en: And I love what I see.
cues.zh: 我爱我所看到的。

cues.en: One more page. And I'll shut up.
cues.zh: 再翻一页。我就闭嘴了。

cues.en: Let me conclude with this one final point. And actually, the president kind of brought it up.
cues.zh: 让我用最后一点来总结。实际上，总统也提到了这一点。

cues.en: Has to do with the movie Philadelphia.
cues.zh: 这与电影《费城故事》有关。

cues.en: She stole my material.
cues.zh: 她偷了我的素材。

cues.en: Many years ago, I did this movie called Philadelphia.
cues.zh: 很多年前，我拍了这部叫《费城故事》的电影。

cues.en: We filmed some of the scenes right here on campus.
cues.zh: 我们在这里的校园里拍摄了一些场景。

cues.en: Philadelphia came out in 1993. Most of you were probably still in diapers. Some of the professors too.
cues.zh: 《费城故事》于1993年上映。你们大多数人可能还在穿尿布。一些教授也是。

cues.en: That cracked me up.
cues.zh: 这让我笑翻了。

cues.en: But it was a good movie. Rent it on, uh, what do you call it, Netflix. It's a good movie. Rent it.
cues.zh: 但那是一部好电影。在，呃，叫什么来着，Netflix上租来看。那是一部好电影。租来看。

cues.en: I get 23 cents every time you rent it. Please rent it.
cues.zh: 你们每租一次，我能得到23美分。请租来看。

cues.en: True. Parents up there, rent, rent, rent it. Netflix. Please.
cues.zh: 是真的。那边的父母们，租，租，租来看。Netflix。拜托了。

cues.en: Tell your friends too.
cues.zh: 也告诉你的朋友们。

cues.en: It's about a man played by Tom Hanks, who's fired from his law firm because he has AIDS. He wants to sue the firm, but no one's willing to represent him until the homophobic ambulance chaser lawyer played by yours truly takes on the case.
cues.zh: 讲的是一个汤姆·汉克斯扮演的男人，因为患有艾滋病被律所解雇。他想起诉律所，但没人愿意代理他，直到一个恐同的、像追逐救护车的律师，也就是我本人，接下了这个案子。

cues.en: And the way, if you watch the movie, you'll see everything I'm talking about today.
cues.zh: 而且，如果你看了这部电影，你就会看到我今天所说的一切。

cues.en: You'll see what I mean about taking risk or being willing to fail.
cues.zh: 你就会明白我说的承担风险或愿意失败的意思。

cues.en: Because taking risk is not just about going for a job.
cues.zh: 因为承担风险不仅仅是关于找一份工作。

cues.en: It's also about knowing what you know and what you don't know.
cues.zh: 它也关乎了解你知道什么，以及你不知道什么。
